# Life Sciences at Illinois

> Central hub for Life Sciences operations, facilities, and research at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, providing access to shared equipment, IT support, and research resources.

Life Sciences at Illinois serves the MCB, IB, and other life science departments at UIUC, offering facilities management, equipment scheduling, technical support, and research infrastructure. The site aggregates resources for faculty, researchers, and students across multiple life science disciplines.

## Key Topics

- Life Sciences
- MCB (Molecular and Cellular Biology)
- IB (Integrative Biology)
- Facilities and Operations
- Equipment Scheduling
- UIUC
- Microscopy Facilities
- IT Resources
- Technical Support
- Research Infrastructure
- Zoom
- Moodle
- FileMaker
- Lab Resources
- Computing and Networking

## Facilities and Equipment

- [Life Sciences Facilities and Operations](http://www.life.illinois.edu/facilities): Life Sciences Facilities and Operations Unit overview and services
- [MCB & IB Scheduler](https://scheduler.life.illinois.edu/): Equipment scheduling tool for MCB, IB, and CDB microscopy facilities

## Support and Resources

- [Help and Support](http://www.life.illinois.edu/help): Help and support resources for Life Sciences at UIUC including IT tools

## Research

- [Meroueh Lab Research](https://merouehlab.life.illinois.edu/research/): Meroueh Lab research on KRAS mutations and pancreatic cancer drug discovery
